research_notes: The eventual long-run system can treat runtime cap, checkpoint cadence, planned gap, and parallelism as separate control knobs with staged validation.
Trying to optimize all simultaneously would make failures difficult to attribute.
The current program's sequencing is therefore not merely conservative; it improves experimental identifiability.
Once each knob has a validated baseline, combined optimization can proceed with fewer surprises.
The runtime cap is the foundational knob being studied now.
No other knob is changed in this sample.
